name: Larry Grable
office: Saugus Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Larry Grable is a business owner and patent attorney. His priorities include safe and supportive schools, academic excellence, responsible stewardship of public funds, and preparing students to use artificial intelligence responsibly. He proposes regular board review of campus safety plans, clear districtwide behavior expectations, and measurable academic goals with early intervention for struggling students. He also supports age-appropriate AI rules covering classroom use, academic integrity, student privacy, and teacher oversight, and has proposed holding regular town-hall meetings with parents and teachers.
